paper_source_package.note: arXiv source package of arXiv:1511.03189v2, holding LoopholeFreeBellTest.tex (Table I) and anc/LHFSupplementary.pdf (Tables S-I and S-II). Every count in this file was read from those two documents.

raw_data_alice.note: Alice's compressed timetags for run 02-54, 1.5 GB. Not hashed: the control needs only the two published counts, and the violating record already pins a streamed hash to show the raw archives are reachable.

raw_data_bob.note: Bob's compressed timetags for run 02-54, 1.6 GB. Not hashed, for the same reason.

raw_data_processing.note: NIST 'Data analysis flow', the official description of how the timetags become per-trial settings and outcomes.

repository.note: Landing page of the NIST Bell test repository, carrying the licence notice for the data and software. Not hashed: it is a mutable web page, last updated 2025-04-15.

provenance.role: Non-violation control. The pump laser lost mode-lock towards the end of this run and the authors report no evidence against local realism for pulse 6, with the same apparatus, the same inequality and the same hypothesis test as the violating run.
provenance.stopping_rule: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Supplemental Material Sec. I B: the cut point was fixed before the analysis, exactly as for the violating run.
provenance.successes: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Supplemental Material Table S-I, run '02-54 (first run)', column 'pulse 6', row 'N_S'.
provenance.sufficiency: Same sufficiency argument as the violating run: Eq. (S2) needs only N and N_S. The Supplemental Material publishes no settings-by-outcome table for this run, so no settings frequencies are available and no settings-bias diagnostic can be computed from it.
provenance.total_trials: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Supplemental Material Table S-I, N_Total of run '02-54 (first run)'.
provenance.trials_in_T: Shalm et al., A strong loophole-free test of local realism, Phys. Rev. Lett. 115, 250402 (2015), Supplemental Material Table S-I, run '02-54 (first run)', column 'pulse 6', row 'N Cut Point'.

title: Trial counts, Shalm et al. (2015) run '02-54' (first run), single pulse 6
